source: U.S. National Weather Service — Active Alerts
name: U.S. National Weather Service — Active Alerts
scheduleDescription: Checked approximately every 10 minutes (external timer plus a GitHub Actions schedule as backup). Actual run times may be delayed.
provides: Active NWS watches, warnings and advisories with event type, severity, urgency, certainty, effective/expiry times and affected areas.
coverage: United States and its territories only. No coverage outside the United States.
coverageLimitations: Zone-based alerts are drawn using simplified zone outlines, so boundaries are approximate. Alerts may be issued, updated or cancelled between project refreshes. Always follow official NWS and local authority instructions.
licenseOrAttribution: Source: U.S. National Weather Service (NOAA). NWS information is in the U.S. public domain.
